items.title: Samsung To Showcase Latest Gaming Innovations at Gamescom 2026
items.what_happened: Samsung Electronics today announced its participation at Gamescom 2026, taking place at Koelnmesse in Cologne, Germany, from Aug. 26-30. There, the company will showcase its full-stack gaming vision that seamlessly connects various gaming platforms. As the world’s largest gaming event, Gamescom features approximately 1,500 software, hardware and game content companies. The event attracted 360,000 visitors […]
